contentBlocks.text: SASSA Grant Eligibility for NSFAS-Funded Students

NSFAS-funded students are generally not eligible for SRD R370 or other social grants, because NSFAS already covers living allowances. However, if your NSFAS funding has been cancelled or completed, you may qualify.

items: Active NSFAS recipients are excluded from all SASSA grants
If your NSFAS was cancelled, you need a cancellation letter from NSFAS
If you completed your studies, you need a completion certificate from your institution

steps.title: Request NSFAS letter
steps.description: Request a NSFAS cancellation or completion letter via the myNSFAS portal.

steps.title: Confirm registry update
steps.description: Wait for confirmation that your name has been removed from the active bursary registry.

steps.title: Apply for SASSA
steps.description: Submit your SASSA application with the NSFAS letter attached as proof.

faqs.question: I finished my degree but SASSA says I am still funded by NSFAS. Why?
faqs.answer: NSFAS databases are not always updated immediately. Upload your graduation certificate or academic transcript along with a NSFAS completion letter to trigger the update.

faqs.question: Can I get a SASSA grant during my NSFAS-funded vacation?
faqs.answer: No. If you are registered as an active NSFAS student, you are excluded from SASSA grants for the full academic year, including vacation months.
